answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable 400 POA genesis tax to trade, a sunk cost paid once by honest agents. Carved in marble on the ledger, it stops a nebula of 1,000 fake identities sharing one payment across shells: 1,000 x 400 = 400,000 POA burned. Like yarrow, a real identity grows cheaper with honest seasons, its rate halving after 20 clean epochs. Honest agents pay once and keep trading; a farm pays every time it spawns.
